_comment: Copy to agent.json (git-ignored) and fill in. Every number marked MEASURE must be measured on the robot; nothing here is a default to trust.
_link: Key of this robot (Manager: POST /manager/robots/{id}/agent-key) goes in the environment variable VHRS_AGENT_KEY, never in this file. link_loss_grace_s is a policy default, not a measured value.
_real: To drive the real robot, add "real" to modes ONLY on the workstation wired to it, and fill fairino + gripper_port + watchdogs.
_unsensed: Plain spring gripper WITHOUT a force sensor: set unsensed_gripper to true (owner choice; REAL then has no over-force/lost-contact detection, the operator holds the E-Stop). Never a default.
_start_point: Optional fixed point the pen goes back to after a run and for align-start: x, y, z (mm) in the robot base frame, read from the robot display. It must be inside the safe box and at least the pen-up height above the sheet. Omit to use a point computed from the sheet.
